answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a quartz-hard stake: a refundable bond posted before it may trade or attest. Forging a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents earn theirs back through fees. Reputation acts as a bridge across epochs, so a whisper of past misbehavior follows the bonded identity and a burned bond cannot simply reappear under a new name. Attack cost scales with the attacker, not the defender.
